userStories.title: Schema extensions for Phase 2 plug-points + PRD citations
acceptanceCriteria: DebateStageConfigSchema({ enabled: false, resolverType: "synthesis", sessionMode: "one-shot", rounds: 1 }).parse(...) accepts selector.kind === "verifier-pick", preserves selector.patch fields when provided, and leaves patch.overlapThreshold / patch.maxDeltas undefined when omitted so defaults are applied at strategy time rather than parse time

DebateStageConfigSchema({ enabled: false, resolverType: "synthesis", sessionMode: "one-shot", rounds: 1 }).parse(...) accepts postDebateVerifier.kind === "plan-checklist" and preDebatePhase.kind === "grounder" with onBlocker / onFailure values from the allowed enums, and rejects invalid enum values with a ZodError

DebateConfigSchema.parse(...) accepts stages.plan.evidenceMode === "asymmetric", defaults stages.plan.evidenceMode to "current" when omitted, rejects unknown evidenceMode values, and rejects evidenceMode outside the plan stage
validatePlanOutput() accepts legacy PRD output that omits verifiedBy, intent, and contextFiles[].factId fields without changing existing stories
validatePlanOutput() preserves verifiedBy, intent, and contextFiles[].factId when those additive citation fields are present in a PRD
validatePlanOutput() rejects invalid verifiedBy.kind values outside "test" | "symbol" | "file"
suggestedCriteria: DebateStageConfigSchema parse returns selector.patch.onFailure === "use-unpatched" when patch.onFailure is explicitly set to "use-unpatched"
DebateStageConfigSchema parse rejects selector: { kind: "verifier-pick" } with an unknown extra field when the verifier-pick variant schema uses strict validation
DebateConfigSchema.parse({}) returns result.stages.plan.evidenceMode === "current" (default applied when stages.plan is entirely absent)

userStories.title: Citation parser + manifest threading + file-read flag
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Implement the citation parsing utility, thread the facts manifest into proposer inputs, and gate the file-read instruction in plan-builder on the fileReadAccess flag.

**Motivation** — Proposers must see the grounding manifest and be prompted to cite factIds; the citation parser enables mechanical scoring in the verifier-pick selector.

**Approach**

`src/debate/citations.ts` exports:
```typescript
export interface ParsedClaim {
  text: string;
  factIds: string[];   // e.g. ["F-014", "S-001"]
  cited: boolean;
}

export function extractClaims(proposalOutput: string): ParsedClaim[];
export function citationRate(claims: ParsedClaim[]): number;  // fraction cited
export function citationDistribution(claims: ParsedClaim[], manifest: FactsManifest): {
  verifiedFacts: number; specSpans: number; uncited: number;
};
```

Parser priority order:
1. **Structured-output mode** — if proposal contains a JSON `claims` array per the citation prompt, use `parseLLMJson` (SSOT from `src/utils/llm-json`) to extract.
2. **Regex fallback** — extract `factId` references inline (`[F-001]`, `(F-001, S-002)`).
3. **Tolerance** — proposers that emit no citations return zero-rate; downstream verifier flags this. Parser does NOT throw.

`citationRate(claims)` returns 0 when claims is empty; otherwise returns `claims.filter(c => c.cited).length / claims.length`.

`citationDistribution(claims, manifest)` returns `{ verifiedFacts: N, specSpans: M, uncited: K }` where `verifiedFacts` counts citations to factIds whose `verification.status === "verified"` in the manifest.

**Manifest threading:**
- Add `manifestSection?: string` to `DebateProposeInput` in `src/operations/debate-propose.ts`.
- In `src/debate/runner.ts` (runPanelOneShot) and `src/debate/runner-plan.ts`, pass `preDebatePhaseResult.manifestSection` (when present) into the proposer prompt context.
- In `src/prompts/builders/debate-builder.ts`, `proposeSlot()` gates the citation requirement section on `stageConfig.proposers?.citationsRequired === true`. When false/undefined, output is byte-equivalent to current behavior.

**File-read flag:**
- In `src/prompts/builders/plan-builder.ts`, gate the existing "file names and structure only" / "do NOT assert specific line numbers" instruction on `proposers.fileReadAccess !== true`.
- When `fileReadAccess === true`, remove that constraint and add: *"You may use file-read tools to verify spec claims against actual code. Cite the resulting factId from the manifest, or include a verbatim: excerpt with path:line-range for any claim derived from a file you read directly."*
- When `fileReadBudget` is set, include the substring `"up to <N> file reads"` in the file-read instruction.

**Scope** — In: src/debate/citations.ts (new), src/operations/debate-propose.ts, src/debate/runner.ts, src/debate/runner-plan.ts, src/prompts/builders/debate-builder.ts, src/prompts/builders/plan-builder.ts. Out: selector scoring (US-003), grounder strategy (US-003).
acceptanceCriteria: extractClaims(output) marks claims as cited when citations are provided either as inline factId markers (for example [F-001]) or as structured JSON claims[].factIds parsed via parseLLMJson, and marks uncited prose claims with cited === false instead of throwing
citationRate(claims) returns 0 for an empty claim set and otherwise returns the fraction of claims where cited === true
citationDistribution(claims, manifest) returns { verifiedFacts, specSpans, uncited } with verifiedFacts counting only citations whose manifest verification.status === "verified"
DebateProposeInput includes manifestSection?: string, and both runPanelOneShot() and runner-plan.ts pass preDebatePhaseResult.manifestSection into every proposer call when it is available

When stageConfig.proposers?.citationsRequired === true, DebatePromptBuilder.proposeSlot(i) includes a citations-required instruction; when the flag is false or omitted, the proposal prompt remains byte-equivalent to current behavior

When stageConfig.proposers?.fileReadAccess === true, PlanPromptBuilder.build() removes the "file names and structure only" restriction, adds a file-read permission instruction, and includes "up to <N> file reads" when fileReadBudget is set; when the flag is false or omitted, the output remains byte-equivalent to current behavior
suggestedCriteria: extractClaims returns an empty array when proposalOutput is an empty string
citationDistribution returns { verifiedFacts: 0, specSpans: 0, uncited: 0 } when claims is empty
citationDistribution correctly categorizes citations to specClaims (S-NNN factIds) as specSpans rather than verifiedFacts
extractClaims handles multiple factIds in a single citation (e.g. [F-001, F-002]) by adding both to the claim's factIds array

userStories.title: grounder pre-phase strategy + verifier-pick selector + patch step
acceptanceCriteria: grounderStrategy is registered under "grounder" and, when ctx.specContent is present, invokes callOp(ctx.ctx, groundOp, { specContent, codebaseContext, workdir }) without passing model / agent fields on the input, writes the resulting manifest to .nax/runs/<runId>/plan/<storyId>/facts-manifest.json, and returns renderManifestSection(result)
grounderStrategy returns { manifestSection: "", costUsd: 0 } when ctx.specContent is empty and does not read nonexistent ctx.stageConfig.preDebatePhase.model or .agent fields

verifierPickSelector is registered under "verifier-pick" and ranks proposals with a documented linear combination of citationRate, citationDistributionScore, failureModesCovered, and contextFilesValidRate before returning the highest-scoring proposal output
When selector.patch.enabled is false or omitted, or when AC overlap between the top two proposals is at or above overlapThreshold, verifierPickSelector skips patching and returns the unpatched winner
When selector.patch.enabled === true and AC overlap is below overlapThreshold (default 0.8), verifierPickSelector invokes the patch step exactly once and returns the patched output

runPatchStep continues inside the winner's existing session by calling ctx.agentManager.runAsSession(winner.proposal.agentName, winner.proposal.handle, prompt, { storyId, pipelineStage: "plan" }) exactly once and returns the resulting output and estimatedCostUsd without reopening a fresh proposal session

When the patch step throws, verifierPickSelector returns the unpatched winner and logs a warning when patch.onFailure is "use-unpatched" or omitted, and returns outcome === "failed" when patch.onFailure === "block"
suggestedCriteria: verifierPickSelector returns outcome === "failed" when ctx.proposals is empty
grounderStrategy logs a warning with storyId when groundOp invocation fails before re-throwing or degrading
verifierPickSelector(ctx) returns the sole proposal's output directly when ctx.proposals has exactly one entry (no scoring needed)
computeScore returns contextFilesValidRate === 1.0 when the proposal has no contextFiles entries (vacuously valid)

userStories.title: plan-checklist verifier + spec-deltas.md formatter
acceptanceCriteria: planChecklistVerifier is registered under "plan-checklist" and returns outcome === "failed" when ctx.selectorResult.output cannot be parsed as a valid PRD

planChecklistVerifier performs the five mechanical checks (files-exist, ac-anchored, claims-cited, no-contradictions, spec-coverage) and emits findings with the documented checklistItem / severity pairings, including blocker findings for missing contextFiles on disk and contradicted factIds in the manifest
planChecklistVerifier returns outcome === "failed" when blocker findings are present and outcome === "passed" otherwise, subject to the postDebateVerifier.onBlocker policy override
formatSpecDeltas(blockers, manifest) returns markdown sections for contradicted spec claims, unverified factual spec claims, and spec gaps surfaced by the codebase
When blocker findings are produced, planChecklistVerifier writes spec-deltas markdown to .nax/runs/<runId>/plan/<storyId>/spec-deltas.md and includes that artifact path in its returned output field

When postDebateVerifier.onBlocker is "block" or omitted, blocker findings cause outcome === "failed"; when it is "tag-expert", the verifier returns outcome === "passed" and emits a downstream-consumable signal that the resulting PRD must be retagged to routing.complexity = "expert" for every story
suggestedCriteria: planChecklistVerifier returns outcome === "passed" with an empty findings array when the PRD has no contextFiles, all ACs have verifiedBy or intent: true, and the manifest has no contradicted claims
formatSpecDeltas returns a non-empty string even when manifest.gaps is empty (sections with no entries are omitted rather than showing empty headers)
planChecklistVerifier does not throw when the manifest artifact file does not exist on disk (treats all claims as uncited/unverified)

userStories.title: evidenceMode preset + plan-runner orchestration wiring
acceptanceCriteria: buildPlanComposition() leaves the plan stage unchanged when evidenceMode === "current" and, when evidenceMode === "asymmetric", injects the asymmetric defaults for preDebatePhase, proposers, sessionMode, selector.patch, and postDebateVerifier

buildPlanComposition() preserves explicit user overrides over the asymmetric macro, including user-specified selector and preDebatePhase values, and is invoked before createDebateRunner() is constructed in src/cli/plan.ts

When stageConfig.preDebatePhase is configured, runner-plan.ts invokes resolvePreDebatePhase(...) before proposer fan-out, prepends manifestSection to the proposal taskContext when present, and routes pre-phase exceptions according to onFailure: degrade continues with an empty manifestSection and a warning, while block returns outcome === "failed" before any proposer, selector, or verifier work runs

When runPlan() uses sessionMode === "stateful", runner-plan.ts pre-opens one session per resolved debater, uses those handles for the proposal turn, preserves SuccessfulProposal.handle through selector resolution, and closes internally-opened handles only after selector / patch / verifier completion

When stageConfig.postDebateVerifier is configured, runner-plan.ts invokes resolvePostDebateVerifier(...) after selector resolution, propagates the verifier outcome to DebateResult, and rewrites every userStory.routing.complexity in debateResult.output to "expert" before plan.ts writes the PRD when the verifier signals tag-expert
suggestedCriteria: buildPlanComposition() with evidenceMode === "asymmetric" preserves non-plug-point fields from the input stageConfig (e.g. enabled, rounds, timeoutSeconds) unchanged

When stageConfig.evidenceMode === "asymmetric" AND user explicitly sets proposers: { citationsRequired: false }, the returned composition has proposers.citationsRequired === false (user override wins for the entire proposers object)
runner-plan.ts warning log for degrade policy includes the grounder error message as a string (not just the storyId)

analysis: Phase 2 builds on Phase 1's plug-point infrastructure. Verified against the current codebase on 2026-05-11: src/debate/runner.ts already invokes resolvePreDebatePhase(...) before one-shot proposer fan-out and resolvePostDebateVerifier(...) after selector resolution, but src/debate/runner-plan.ts is still a separate orchestration path that bypasses both hooks and goes straight from proposal fan-out to resolveOutcome(). That means plan-mode Phase 2 wiring is not just policy handling; US-005 must add actual pre-phase dispatch, manifest threading, post-verifier dispatch, and result propagation in runPlan(). The schemas-debate.ts already has postDebateVerifier with plan-checklist in the kind enum, proposers object, preDebatePhase {kind: grounder|custom}, and the selector discriminated union with 5 kinds. CRITICAL: preDebatePhase uses .strict() which blocks adding onFailure — Phase 2 US-001 must remove .strict() when adding the onFailure field. DebateStageConfigSchema is a FACTORY FUNCTION taking defaults, not a plain schema — tests must call it with defaults before parsing. src/prd/schema.ts is a custom validator (not Zod-based at the PRD object level) and currently treats acceptanceCriteria as string[] plus contextFiles as string[]; adding verifiedBy/intent/factId means extending validateStory() with optional field handling, not introducing a separate top-level Zod parse path. DebateProposeInput (src/operations/debate-propose.ts) needs manifestSection?: string added, but plan mode also builds prompts directly via DebatePromptBuilder, so runner-plan.ts needs its own manifest threading. SuccessfulProposal in session-helpers.ts already has handle?: SessionHandle, but current runPlan() uses the prompt-form sessionManager.runInSession(...), which opens and closes the session within a single call and does not preserve a live handle for the selector patch step. To make verifier-pick patching real, runPlan() must follow the stateful/hybrid pattern: pre-open per-debater sessions, use those handles for proposal turns, retain them through selector resolution, then close them in finally after patch/verifier work completes. PostDebateVerifierContext lacks manifest — plan-checklist verifier must read it from disk at .nax/runs/<runId>/plan/<storyId>/facts-manifest.json (consistent with grounder writing it there). The patch step uses agentManager.runAsSession (Layer 3 sanctioned continuation per adapter-wiring.md Rule 3). PatchPromptBuilder goes in src/prompts/builders/patch-builder.ts (forbidden-patterns.md Prompt Builder Convention). New files: src/debate/citations.ts, src/debate/pre-phase/grounder.ts, src/debate/selectors/verifier-pick.ts, src/debate/verifiers/plan-checklist.ts, src/plan/spec-deltas.ts, src/prompts/builders/patch-builder.ts. src/plan/ directory does not yet exist. evidenceMode is plan-stage-only and is added via Zod merge (PlanStageExtensions merged into plan-stage schema); other stages must reject it. All logger calls must include storyId as first key per project-conventions.md. All glob scans must pass cwd explicitly per monorepo-awareness.md. No process.cwd() outside CLI entry points. File writes use Bun.write(), reads use Bun.file().text().
